title: A 6.3μW 20b Incremental Zoom-ADC with 6ppm INL and 1μV Offset Youngcheol Chae1, Kamran Souri2, Kofi A.A. Makinwa2
figure_number: Figure 15.5.2 shows a simplified circuit diagram of the ADC. Each integrator is realized with a pseudo-differential inverter-based amplifier. During the sampling phase φ1, the input voltage Vi is sampled on all 64 elements CS, 1-64 (160fF each) of the Cap-DAC. At the same time, the 1st integrator’s amplifier is configured for unity-gain and auto-zeroed with the help of offset-storage capacitor CC. During the integration phase φ2, m elements can be connected to either Vref+ or Vref-,
design_purpose: As shown in Fig. 15.5.3, it consists of a cascoded inverter, which is dynamically biased to enhance its immunity to process, supply, and temperature variations.
